This also bypasses the previous unknown-command NACK fallback, so callers can receive a success-shaped response for an operation that was not performed. The unit tests assert debug text but do not verify the response semantics or command execution.","Negative-case coverage does not verify the contract’s recovery behavior: after a full debug ring is drained, the test does not confirm a new log is accepted; after simulated USART2 TX failure, it resets busy state but does not send a subsequent frame and assert ACK; after relay timeout, it does not verify a successful subsequent cascade send/response.","The only recorded compile/test command excludes main.c, although the candidate substantially refactors startup and the main loop to integrate debug draining. No full firmware build or main-loop integration evidence is present.
